quarterly_data.signal: First half ended September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 140,980 million (+4.3%), operating income JPY 14,333 million (+0.6%), ordinary income JPY 12,923 million (-16.5%), profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 6,308 million (-31.4%). Segments: Semiconductor Equipment-Related net sales JPY 88,378 million (+5.2%), operating income JPY 8,190 million (-2.1%); Electronic Devices net sales JPY 28,090 million (+21.7%), operating income JPY 5,823 million (+45.9%); Automotive-Related net sales JPY 15,991 million (+11.8%), operating income JPY 1,454 million (+9.9%); Other net sales JPY 8,520 million (-37.9%), operating loss JPY 301 million. Management states the Semiconductor Equipment-Related business served Western customers' sourcing outside China mainly from Malaysia while capturing Chinese domestic demand; ceramics grew sharply and quartz and CVD-SiC also rose, while depreciation and start-up costs of new factories weighed on profit. Thermo-module shipments for optical transceivers grew on strong generative-AI server investment. R&D expenses JPY 6,067 million.
